args.title: Document report field limits in API reference
args.body:
File: docs/api-reference.md

Add documentation to the API reference specifying the limits on report fields, including the maximum of 20 recipients for scheduled exports, the 120-character limit on report names, and the maximum of 50 categories in lists. This helps users understand validation constraints and improves form validation on the client side.
